_about: 3D SRAM 논문 A의 정본 상수. 모든 스크립트와 문서는 이 파일의 값을 인용한다. 등급: measured(실측) / measured-derived(실측 회귀) / third-party(외부 벤치) / deck(소자팀 v2.0 덱) / slack(소자팀 슬랙 회신, 미문서화) / assumption(우리 가정) / scenario(민감도 축).

llama31_8b_embedding_bytes.source: 128256 x 4096 x 2 B; LM head untied, same size

llama31_8b_weight_read_per_step_GB.source: all params minus embedding table (LM head IS read every decode step). Replaces rounded 15.1 (+0.6%) and the block-only 13.959 (excludes LM head, -7%).

llama31_8b_kv_bytes_per_token.source: 32 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 x 2 (K,V) x 2 B

hbm_pin_TBs.source: NVIDIA B200; HBM<->L2 link rate, NOT a compute-delivered rate

hbm_effective_TBs_llama.source: slope of step_ms = t0 + logical_GB / B over 4 measured decode anchors (B=1/8/32 N=2048, B=8 N=8192), vLLM 0.28.0. Causal marginal rate NOT validated: existing B200 microbenchmarks are latency-bound (0.8 TB/s achieved).

t0_ms_llama.source: same fit; compute + launch + latency, not traffic

l2_to_sm_TBs.source: Chips and Cheese Vulkan compute-shader microbenchmark; 21 within partition, 16.8 across. Read path only.

l2_hit_on_streaming_decode.source: reuse distance = working set (18 GB) >> 126 MB. Verify with lts__t_sectors_hit_rate.

macro_read_GBs.source: 128 b x 1.4 GHz (Si 2.0 GHz x 0.7 user assumption)

bits_per_macro.source: reproduces 2664 macros -> 333 MB raw; Mb vs Mib unresolved (+4.86% if 2^20)

array_peak_320mm2_TBs.source: 2664 x 22.4 GB/s, all macros read simultaneously

read_projection_320mm2_TBs.source: 59.7 / 3.37; derate = model H100 L2 12.8 / measured 3.8 (Chips and Cheese). Read-oriented. Bound to the 320 mm2 point.

derate.source: H100 L2 anchored; not a property of the array; becomes moot when the fabric is the cap

bw_r_table_slack.source: 2026-09-20 01:30 Q4; 15 = 17.7 x eta_sched 0.85; eta_bank(r, N_bank=16) form not given; r=0.6 value equals the deck's H100 L2 3.8 (coincidence unconfirmed). Implied beta_W 0.25 (r=0.8) / 0.12 (r=0.6); not one constant beta.

thermal_cap_example_TBs.source: P/E with 0.5 pJ/bit and 20 W, Q3; E/bit unmeasured per device team

c1_lower_si_mm2_per_320mm2_tier.source: Q2; scales with tier area -> C1 infeasible at full-die coverage

die_area_mm2.source: B200-class planning outline; NOT legal placement area

net_placeable_area_mm2_per_die_per_layer.source: 3DSRAM_AREA_BUDGET.md; 800 = full placement geometric upper bound; legal polygon unknown

tier_path.source: our architecture choice; deck is silent

read_delivery_cap_TBs.source: three caps carried in parallel until path and fabric are defined; at >=500 mm2 the array raw (>=187 TB/s) exceeds all three, so delivered BW is cap-bound and area-independent

beta_W.source: write/fill capability relative to read; device team has not supplied
